title: Controller communication loss
description: The controller's Wi-Fi link drops for 20 s. The (simulated) controller keeps running its local protection; the server simply receives nothing.
what_to_look_for: Nodes go Stale after 3 s; with no valid data from any node the feeder is UNKNOWN. After 10 s the controller is declared offline.
The explanation states that this is NOT evidence of an interruption and that local protection is unaffected.
One CONTROLLER_COMM_LOST event; no NODE_OFFLINE or interruption events.
When reports resume, the feeder re-initialises and returns to NORMAL.
